## Path phases

::: {.phase-grid role="list" aria-label="MGenética path phases"}
::: {.phase-card role="listitem"}
**01 · Foundations**

Animal breeding logic and genetic decomposition of phenotype.

[Start phase](modulo01-introducao-ao-melhoramento-animal.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Start foundations phase with Module 01"}
:::

::: {.phase-card role="listitem"}
**02 · Data and parameters**

Exploration, variance, heritability, repeatability and correlations.

[Start phase](modulo03-estatistica-descritiva-e-exploracao-de-dados-no-r.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Start data phase with Module 03"}
:::

::: {.phase-card role="listitem"}
**03 · Modeling**

Mixed models, BLUP, pedigree and relationship.

[Start phase](modulo07-modelos-lineares-e-modelos-mistos.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Start modeling phase with Module 07"}
:::

::: {.phase-card role="listitem"}
**04 · Genomics**

SNPs, quality control, genomic matrices, GWAS and prediction.

[Start phase](modulo10-introducao-a-genomica-e-marcadores-snp.qmd){.entry-link aria-label="Start genomics phase with Module 10"}
:::
:::

## All modules

::: {.module-grid role="list" aria-label="All course modules"}
::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**01**

[Introduction to Animal Breeding](modulo01-introducao-ao-melhoramento-animal.qmd)

Selection response and breeding-program logic.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**02**

[Foundations of Quantitative Genetics](modulo02-bases-da-genetica-quantitativa.qmd)

Genetic value, phenotype, environment and variation.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**03**

[Descriptive statistics and exploration in R](modulo03-estatistica-descritiva-e-exploracao-de-dados-no-r.qmd)

First diagnostics, distributions and exploratory interpretation.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**04**

[Means, variances and components](modulo04-medias-variancias-e-componentes-de-variancia.qmd)

Phenotypic, genetic and environmental variance.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**05**

[Heritability and repeatability](modulo05-herdabilidade-e-repetibilidade.qmd)

Parameters that connect observations to genetic predictability.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**06**

[Genetic and phenotypic correlations](modulo06-correlacoes-geneticas-e-fenotipicas.qmd)

Trait relationships and indirect selection effects.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**07**

[Linear and mixed models](modulo07-modelos-lineares-e-modelos-mistos.qmd)

Fixed effects, random effects and error.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**08**

[BLUP and genetic evaluation](modulo08-blup-e-avaliacao-genetica.qmd)

Breeding-value prediction and candidate comparison.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**09**

[Pedigree and relationship](modulo09-estrutura-de-pedigree-e-parentesco.qmd)

Genealogy, relationship matrices and individual connections.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**10**

[Genomics and SNP markers](modulo10-introducao-a-genomica-e-marcadores-snp.qmd)

Molecular markers in evaluation and data control.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**11**

[Genomic quality control](modulo11-controle-de-qualidade-de-dados-genomicos.qmd)

Filters, genotype consistency and genomic-analysis preparation.
:::

::: {.module-card role="listitem"}
**12**

[Genomic matrices, GWAS and prediction](modulo12-matrizes-genomicas-gwas-e-predicao-genomica.qmd)

Genomic relationship, association and prediction.
:::
:::
